an6.106:1.1: tisso imā bhikkhave taṇhā pahātabbā tayo ca mānā
an6.106:1.8: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno imā tisso taṇhā pahīnā honti ime ca tayo mānā
an6.106:1.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu acchejji taṇhaṃ vivattayi saññojanaṃ sammā mānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassāti.
an6.106:2.6: dutiyapaṇṇāsako niṭṭhito. paṇṇāsakāsaṅgahito vaggo tikavaggo paṭhamo 107
